title: Are brain waves the next unlock for physical AI?
slides: Could brain waves make robots move like us?
Neural signals now control prosthetic limbs directly.
But muscle-free movement is not the real breakthrough.
This lets robots learn motion from your mind.
Test a thought-controlled arm today—your brain is ready.
thread_text:
1. Mind over muscle?

Prosthetic limbs now decode neural signals in real time, bypassing damaged nerves entirely.

2. The real shift

Robots aren't just reading your brain—they're copying motion patterns directly from your thoughts.

3. No training needed

Your neural activity alone teaches the machine how to move, without a single physical gesture.

4. Why that matters

This turns every user into a motion teacher—your mind becomes a training dataset for new movements.

5. Try it now

A thought-controlled arm demo is live. Can you operate a robotic hand without lifting a finger this week?
